rooms.name: Back Door
rooms.description: The car park behind the church hall — dark, empty, one door
rooms.unlock_text: You pull into the empty car park. No other cars. Just you.

rooms.name: Store Room
rooms.description: The back door of Café 153 — shelves of supplies, cold and dark
rooms.unlock_text: The keypad beeps green. The door clicks open. Cold air and coffee beans.

rooms.name: Brew Station
rooms.description: The espresso machine and grinder — the heart of the café
rooms.unlock_text: You carry supplies to the brew station. The machine is cold.

rooms.name: Service Counter
rooms.description: The front counter — chalkboard, cups, POS, syrups
rooms.unlock_text: The machine is dialed in. Time to set up the counter.

rooms.name: The Floor
rooms.description: The gathering area — tables, chairs, morning sunlight
rooms.unlock_text: Everything's ready behind the counter. Time to set up the floor.
